tools.falsifier: REFUTED IF: the edge is written to the graph rather than parked in the triage inbox (the tool's own contract says it is NEVER written directly), OR the model invents entity ids instead of resolving the seeded names, OR source and target are the same id. NOTE: kg entities live in NEO4J, so there is no SQL seed_assert for the graph side — the glossary assert above pins the NAMES the model must resolve, and the store snapshot covers the Neo4j side.

ship_audit.gate: OWED — Tier A: the proposal must mint a review item, never a direct write.
ship_audit.absent_case: OWED — an entity name that does not exist must be refused, not silently resolved to the nearest match.
